summary: When the Check run hit its hard deadline, turbo-ci-run SIGKILLed turbo and claimed turbo prints the tasks still running; it cannot, so the log said only "deadline reached" and a 207-task cache miss on a 2-core runner was indistinguishable from a wedged task. Fixed by snapshotting the process tree before the kill and printing each running task with its elapsed time and package.
